title: Root Cause Analysis (RCA) in Semiconductor Manufacturing: 8D Reports and Lot Narrowing Methods
excerpt: How do you find the real cause of semiconductor defects? Based on patents and primary sources, this beginner's guide gently explains root cause analysis (RCA), which narrows down the cause using what the tools that defective wafers went through have in common, tool records, and the distribution of defects on the wafer.
